title: Infinite chains of perfect fits for expanding Thurston maps
summary: The topological mating of two postcritically finite polynomials with dendritic Julia sets is encoded by a pair of circle laminations $Λ^{\pm}$, whose collapse produces a sphere-filling curve. When a leaf of $Λ^{+}$ and a leaf of $Λ^{-}$ share an endpoint they form a perfect fit. An unpublished proposition of Epstein, recorded by Petersen and Meyer, shows that for matings of honest degree-$d$ polynomials an infinite-diameter ray equivalence class, i.e. an infinite chain of perfect fits is impossible.
